I played this game, and I'm declaring it's not worth my time. I'm most disappointed by the fact that a lot of time and effort was put into the voices, the incredibly cute 2D characters, and the optimized 3D ship models -- only to have it wrapped by a game more simple than a point-and-click adventure.

There is no game play. You engage in battles by tapping 3 or 4 times on the screen in 20 seconds. Away missions are very tiny puzzles to determine the best crew to send given the mission options. And finally there are shuttle missions which has you send crew away for a chance at getting loot.

I wish it had JRPG elements during the battles and I wish the away missions were more engaging. Like a lot of pay-to-win games, I felt like they were pushing the real-money currency in tricky ways. Finally, every mission (at least for the first hour I played) required a download and could take 5 to 30 seconds to load.
